request.query: cart-service is returning 5xx errors after a deploy

report.summary: cart-service experienced a sudden spike in 5xx errors during the 3‑hour window after the v1.5.0 deploy. The spike coincides with a cluster of NullPointerException logs in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount, indicating a deployment regression that caused null promotion data to be dereferenced.

likely_causes.title: NullPointerException in PromotionEngine.applyDiscount due to null promotion data after deploy
likely_causes.rationale: The 5xx error rate anomaly aligns temporally with the NPE logs, and the logs explicitly reference the PromotionEngine.applyDiscount method where a null value is dereferenced. This points to a regression introduced in the recent deployment that caused the service to return 5xx errors.

next_steps: Verify the contents of the cart-service v1.5.0 artifact to confirm changes to PromotionEngine.applyDiscount
Add defensive null checks around promotion data in applyDiscount
Deploy a hotfix or rollback to the previous stable version
Continuously monitor 5xx error rate and NPE logs to confirm the issue is resolved
